subtitle: Accounting & business management
welcome: A clear start to every day.
intro: Invoices, purchases and business records, together in one place.
notice: Sales, payments, offline sales synchronization and CSV reports are available. Scheduled backups and historical invoice editing are still pending.
catalogDetail: Products, customers, suppliers and payment methods.
invoiceDetail: Weight, amount, pieces and anonymous spice containers in one invoice.

auth.loginIntro: Sign in to your Alanan workspace.
auth.signOutCurrentHelp: Other devices signed in to this account will stay signed in.
auth.accountOffline: Reconnect to change your password or sign out securely.
auth.savePassword: Save password and sign in again
auth.setupHelp: Need access? Ask your system administrator to set up your account.
auth.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
auth.newUserHelp: Choose roles, then adjust this account's individual permissions.
auth.passwordPolicy: Use at least 6 characters and no more than 72 UTF-8 bytes.
auth.permissionsHelp: The selected role fills these defaults. You can turn each permission on or off for this account.
auth.accessSaved: Access updated. This user's other sessions were signed out.
auth.removeUserHelp: Removes the account and signs it out. Past accounting records keep the user's identity.
auth.removeUserConfirm: Delete {{name}}'s account? They will be signed out, and this account will disappear from the directory.

master.archiveConfirm: Archive {{name}}? Existing invoices keep their history, but this record will not appear in new entries.
master.discardConfirm: Discard this unsaved draft… This cannot be undone.
master.title: Business records
master.name: Name
master.defaultCost: Default purchase cost (₪ per unit, optional)
master.defaultCostHelp: Prefills new purchase lines. Changing it does not recalculate existing stock or profit.
master.search: Search by name, code or phone
master.draftRestored: Your unsaved draft was restored. Review it before saving.
master.draftWarning: This browser could not store the draft. Keep this form open until the record is saved.

purchase.draftNotice: Draft saved on this device. The final invoice number is assigned when the server accepts it.
purchase.pendingRetry: This purchase was submitted, but confirmation may be missing. Its contents are locked so retrying cannot create a duplicate. Retry when connected.
purchase.storageError: The browser could not preserve this draft. Keep this page open and enable local storage before saving or refreshing.
purchase.correctionHelp: You can correct the date, reference or notes on an older invoice without changing stock. Changing quantities or costs requires no later stock movements for those products. Product identities, supplier and payments stay unchanged. Give a reason for the audit trail.
purchase.cancelHelp: This reverses stock and cost only when no later stock movement depends on this purchase. Confirm any supplier refund before cancelling a paid invoice.
purchase.refundConfirm: I confirm the supplier has refunded this amount
purchase.approximateStock: Calculated stock is an estimate, not a guarantee of physical stock. Anonymous container sales do not deduct a specific spice.
purchase.closeBeforeUpdate: Finish or close the open form before updating the app.

cancellation.expenseRefund: I confirm this expense was voided or the payment was returned
cancellation.customerRefund: I confirm the customer was refunded
cancellation.supplierRefund: I confirm the supplier returned this payment

errors.BACKUP_SCHEMA_INVALID: The backup does not contain the required Alanan tables.
errors.BACKUP_CHECKSUM_INVALID: The SHA-256 checksum is invalid or does not match the file.
errors.BACKUP_EXPORT_FAILED: Could not create the backup. Check the server's PostgreSQL tools and database connection.
errors.BACKUP_UPLOAD_FAILED: Could not store or verify the backup on the server.
errors.BACKUP_DELETE_FAILED: Could not remove the staged file.
errors.BACKUP_CONFIG_INVALID: The server backup connection is not configured correctly.
errors.BACKUP_RESTORE_TEST_FAILED: The backup could not be restored in a disposable database. Check Docker Desktop and the backend logs.
errors.BACKUP_RESTORE_TEST_UNAVAILABLE: Restore testing is unavailable on this backend. Check the restore script and Docker Desktop.

errors.USER_NOT_FOUND: This user account was not found.
errors.CANNOT_EDIT_SELF_ACCESS: You cannot change your own access here.

errors.PAYMENT_REVERSAL_CONFLICT: This payment cannot be reversed because the invoice's original payment would be affected.
errors.REFUND_RECEIPT_REQUIRED: Confirm the supplier refund before cancelling this paid purchase.
errors.PURCHASE_REVALUATION_REQUIRED: Later stock movements or cost changes depend on this purchase. It cannot be corrected or cancelled automatically.

errors.DELETE_REFUND_REQUIRED: Cancel this paid record and confirm the refund before permanently removing it.

errors.PURCHASE_REFERENCE_REQUIRED: Select a supplier and a product for every item.
errors.SUPPLIER_UNAVAILABLE: This supplier is missing or inactive. Select an active supplier.
errors.PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: An item is missing or inactive. Select active products.
errors.PAYMENT_METHOD_UNAVAILABLE: The payment method is inactive or no default is available. Choose an active method.

errors.PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_TOTAL: Paid now cannot exceed the invoice total.

errors.DUPLICATE_RECORD: This code or name is already in use. Use a different value.

errors.INVALID_TRACKING_TYPE: Spices use kilograms and honey uses pieces.
errors.WALK_IN_PROTECTED: The default walk-in customer cannot be changed.
errors.DEFAULT_MUST_BE_ACTIVE: The default payment method must remain active.
errors.DEFAULT_REQUIRED: Choose another default payment method before removing this default.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The username or password is incorrect, or the account is inactive.
errors.LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait five minutes before trying again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Please sign in again to continue.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to access this page.

errors.INVALID_FIELD: Enter a valid value for this field.

payments.autoHelp: The full payment is allocated to the oldest unpaid invoices first. It cannot exceed this supplier’s outstanding balance.
payments.manualHelp: Enter the amount to pay against each invoice. Allocations must equal the payment amount. Changing supplier clears selected allocations.
payments.draftNotice: Payment draft saved on this device. Saving requires a connection; drafts are not sent automatically.
payments.pendingRetry: Confirmation may be missing. This payment is locked; retry the same request when connected to avoid duplicates.

sales.cancelHelp: Cancellation returns the listed products to calculated stock. Payment history stays visible.
sales.refundConfirm: I confirm this amount was refunded to the customer.
sales.search: Search invoice number, customer, or date
sales.draftNotice: Draft saved on this device. Queue the sale to send it now or automatically when you reconnect.
sales.pendingRetry: This sale was submitted, but confirmation may be missing. Its contents are locked. Retry the same sale when connected to avoid duplicates.
sales.negativeStock: This sale left calculated stock below zero. Review physical stock; the sale was saved and the warning was recorded.
sales.walkInHelp: Leave the customer blank for a walk-in sale. Walk-in sales must be fully paid. Select a named customer to record an unpaid balance.
sales.offlineCustomerHelp: This customer will be saved on this device. Queue the sale to create the customer first, then send the invoice when connected.
sales.customerPending: This customer is saved locally and will be created before the queued sale syncs.
sales.containerHelp: Records container revenue only. No specific spice is selected or deducted; cost remains unknown.

customerPayments.otherDraftCustomer: An unfinished payment for {{name}} is open.
customerPayments.autoHelp: The full payment is allocated to the oldest unpaid sales first. It cannot exceed this customer's outstanding balance.
customerPayments.manualHelp: Enter an amount for each sale. Allocations must equal the payment. Changing customer clears selected allocations.
customerPayments.draftNotice: Payment draft saved on this device. Saving requires a connection; drafts are not sent automatically.
customerPayments.pendingRetry: Confirmation may be missing. This payment is locked; retry the same request when connected to avoid duplicates.

offline.workspaceHelp: The backend is unavailable. You can queue sales using records saved on this device. They will sync after your session reconnects. Other pages need the backend.
offline.title: Offline sales and synchronization
offline.cacheMissing: Offline records are not ready. Connect and refresh before entering sales offline.
offline.sessionHelp: Queued sales stay on this device. They sync automatically after the backend and your session reconnect. Sign-out requires a connection.
offline.cached: Using offline records from {{date}}. The server validates them when syncing.
offline.draftNotice: Drafts stay on this device. Queue a completed sale to save it locally and synchronize automatically when connected.
offline.queued: Sale is saved in the queue. You can start another sale. Check Offline sales and synchronization for its status or any required corrections.

inventory.openingHelp: Record goods you already owned before using this system. Enter their quantity and unit cost; stock and weighted cost update now. This does not create a supplier bill.
inventory.reason: Why are these goods being added?

operations.stockHelp: Waste reduces calculated stock and preserves the current cost. Negative stock is allowed with a recorded warning.
operations.draftNotice: Draft saved on this device. Saving requires a connection; these records are not sent automatically.
operations.pending: Confirmation may be missing. This entry is locked; retry the same entry to avoid duplicates.
operations.negativeStock: This waste record left calculated stock below zero. Review physical stock. The warning was recorded.

reports.scrollHint: Swipe the table sideways to see all columns.
reports.title: Accounting reports
reports.name: Supplier
reports.supplierNote: Purchased and paid use the selected dates. Current debt is the live balance across all dates, after cancellations.
reports.profitNote: This is not exact net profit. Container sales and any product lines without known cost are listed separately and excluded from known margin. Expenses use the selected dates.

dashboard.title: Accounting dashboard
dashboard.profitNote: Profit uses product lines with known cost. Anonymous spice-container revenue and unknown product cost are excluded from exact profit.

backup.title: Backups
backup.help: Only admins can manage backup files. Uploaded files are checked and staged here; uploading never replaces the live database. Keep a downloaded copy off this computer.
backup.uploadHelp: Choose a PostgreSQL custom-format .dump file (up to 512 MB). The app checks its format and required tables, then stores it separately. This is not a full restore test.
backup.restoreTestPassed: Restore test passed: {{purchases}} purchases and {{sales}} sales. The live database was not changed.
backup.liveRestoreHelp: Download this backup and its checksum. Restore it to a separate empty PostgreSQL 18 database, verify the recovered records, then change the backend database connection and restart the backend. This is a separate operator step; the current live database is not replaced from this page.
backup.removeConfirm: Remove this staged backup file? Keep another copy before continuing.
backup.exported: Backup created and downloaded. Store a copy off this computer.
backup.staged: Backup verified and staged. The live database was not changed.

hardDelete.title: Permanently remove record
hardDelete.help: Admin only. This removes the record from normal lists and keeps a deletion audit. Linked payments or later stock movements must be resolved first.
hardDelete.confirm: I understand this cannot be undone
